## Endpoints

| Path | Notes |
|---|---|
| `/health` | GET -> 200 "ok" (liveness) |
| `/api/openapi.json` | GET -> this API as OpenAPI 3.1 JSON |
| `/api/docs` | GET -> readable HTML reference |
| `/auth/v1/signup` | POST {email, password, data?, options:{emailRedirectTo?}} -> session, or user only while the email is unconfirmed (confirmation email sent) |
| `/auth/v1/token` | POST ?grant_type=password {email, password} \| ?grant_type=refresh_token {refresh_token} -> {access_token, refresh_token, expires_in, expires_at, token_type, user}; the refresh token rotates on every refresh |
| `/auth/v1/logout` | POST (Bearer) -> {} ; revokes all refresh tokens of the account |
| `/auth/v1/user` | GET (Bearer) -> user; PUT (Bearer) {password?, data?} -> updated user (data is merged into user_metadata) |
| `/auth/v1/recover` | POST {email, redirect_to?} -> {} ; sends a password-reset link (same answer whether or not the email exists); rate limited |
| `/auth/v1/resend` | POST {type: "signup", email, options:{emailRedirectTo?}} -> {} ; resends the confirmation |
| `/auth/v1/verify` | GET ?type=signup\|recovery&token (the email links) -> 302 to the redirect URL with #access_token=...&refresh_token=...&type=... or #error=... |
| `/auth/v1/settings` | GET -> {external: {email, google, apple}, mailer_autoconfirm} |
| `/auth/v1/authorize` | GET ?provider=google\|apple&redirect_to -> 302 to the provider (PKCE) |
| `/auth/v1/callback` | GET\|POST (from Google/Apple) -> 302 to redirect_to#access_token=...&refresh_token=... or #error=... |
| `/rest/v1/query` | POST table query/mutation, see below |
| `/rest/v1/rpc/<str:name>` | POST server function, see below |
| `/storage/v1/object/sign/<str:bucket>` | POST signed URLs for several paths, see Storage |
| `/storage/v1/object/sign/<str:bucket>/<path:path>` | POST {expiresIn} signed URL for one path; GET ?token= serves the file |
| `/storage/v1/object/<str:bucket>` | DELETE {prefixes} |
| `/storage/v1/object/<str:bucket>/<path:path>` | POST upload (x-upsert: true to replace), PUT replace (Bearer) |
| `/functions/v1/<str:name>` | POST check-email-domain {email} -> {valid, domain?, reason?, checked?} (signup form; rate limited) |

The Django admin (`/django-admin/`) is for staff only and not part of the app API.

## Table queries: `POST /rest/v1/query`

Body (JSON): `{"table", "action", ...}`. Keys read by the server (ejb/query.py): `action`, `count`, `filters`, `head`, `ignoreDuplicates`, `limit`, `maybeSingle`, `offset`, `onConflict`, `order`, `returning`, `select`, `single`, `table`, `values`.

- `action`: delete, insert, select, update, upsert (default select)
- `select`: PostgREST select string: `*`, `col`, `alias:col`, embeds `alias:other_table!fk_name(cols)`; `!inner` keeps only rows whose embed matches
- `filters`: list of `{"col", "op", "value", "negate"?}`, or `{"or": "a.eq.1,b.gt.2"}` / `{"and": "..."}` (PostgREST logic syntax, nested `and(...)`/`or(...)`, `not.` prefix)
- operators: is, in, cs, cd, ov, like, ilike, eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte (`like`/`ilike` use `*` or `%` as wildcard; `is` takes null/true/false; `in` takes a list or `(a,b)`; `cs`/`cd`/`ov` on arrays and JSON)
- `order`: list of `{"col", "ascending"?: true, "nullsFirst"?}`; paging: `limit`, `offset`
- `count`: "exact" -> total in `count`; `head: true` -> only the count
- `single: true` -> one object (406 `PGRST116` unless exactly one row); `maybeSingle: true` -> object or null
- mutations: `values` (object or list; insert/upsert), `onConflict` ("col1,col2"), `ignoreDuplicates`, `returning: true` to get the rows back; update/delete need filters and only touch rows the access rules allow
- response: `{"data": [...] | {...} | null, "count": n | null}`
- errors: HTTP 4xx `{"message", "code", "details", "hint"}` with Postgres/PostgREST codes (`42501` / `new row violates row-level security policy`, `42P01` unknown table, `42703` unknown column, `PGRST100` bad filter, `PGRST116` single row, `23505` duplicate, `P0001` business rule)

| Method + path | Body | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /storage/v1/object/<bucket>/<uid>/<file>` (header `x-upsert: true` to replace; `PUT` = replace) | raw file, `Content-Type` | `{Key, path, id, fullPath}` |
| `POST /storage/v1/object/sign/<bucket>/<path>` | `{expiresIn}` | same list, one entry |
| `POST /storage/v1/object/sign/<bucket>` | `{paths: [...], expiresIn}` | `[{path, signedURL, signedUrl, error}]` |
| `GET <signedURL>` | — | the file (no Authorization header; may be an object-store URL) |
| `DELETE /storage/v1/object/<bucket>` | `{prefixes: [...]}` | `[{name, bucket_id}]` removed |

Rules: signed in; writes and deletes only inside your own folder `<your uid>/`; any signed-in user may get signed URLs (max 7 days). Images are compressed by the client before upload.

- bucket `avatars`: public=False, max size=5242880 bytes, types=image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp

## Realtime websocket

Connect to `wss://<api host>/realtime/v1/websocket` (`ws://` locally). From core/realtime.py:

```
Live updates over websockets (what Supabase Realtime did), with Django Channels.

  model save/delete (ejb/realtime.py, sent after commit) -> Channels group
  "rt.<table>" (Redis) -> each connected client's subscriptions -> filter
  match + row permission check -> pushed to the browser.

Permission check: before sending an INSERT/UPDATE, the row is re-read as that
user, so row-level security decides who receives what (Supabase did the same).
DELETE events carry only the primary key, as Supabase's did.

Client messages:   {"type": "auth", "token": "..."}
                   {"type": "subscribe", "id": "s1", "table": "tables", "event": "*", "filter": "city=eq.Pejë"}
                   {"type": "unsubscribe", "id": "s1"}
Server messages:   {"type": "subscribed", "id": "s1"}
                   {"type": "change", "id": "s1", "payload": {schema, table, eventType, new, old, commit_timestamp}}
```

- tables with live events: `lesson_participants`, `lessons`, `memberships`, `messages`, `notifications`, `requests`, `tables`
- at most 50 subscriptions per connection; filter ops: eq, neq, lt, lte, gt, gte, in
- send `auth` again with the new access token after a refresh

## Access rules per table (`/rest/v1/query`, realtime)

From ejb/policies.py (the former row-level security). Everything requires a signed-in user; what is not listed is refused. Server functions do their own checks. `me` = the signed-in user.

| Table | select | insert | update (rows / new values) | delete |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `admin_audit_log` | admins only | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `affinity` | own rows (`user_id` = me) | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `badges` | everyone (signed in) | `o.user_id == me` | nobody | nobody |
| `bans` | own rows (`user_id` = me); admins: all | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `blocks` | `Q(blocker_id=me) \| Q(blocked_id=me)` | `o.blocker_id == me` | nobody | own rows (`blocker_id` = me) |
| `connection_picks` | own rows (`picker_id` = me) | `o.picker_id == me and is_member(me, o.table_id)` | nobody | nobody |
| `connections` | `Q(a_id=me) \| Q(b_id=me)` | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `lesson_participants` | custom rule `_lesson_participants_select` | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `lesson_subjects` | everyone (signed in) | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `lessons` | custom rule `_lessons_select` | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `memberships` | everyone (signed in) | `o.user_id == me and Request.objects.filter(table_id=o.table_id, user_id=me, status='approved').exists()` | nobody | nobody |
| `messages` | `Q(Exists(Membership.objects.filter(table_id=OuterRef('table_id'), user_id=me)))` | `o.sender_id == me and is_member(me, o.table_id)` | nobody | nobody |
| `notifications` | own rows (`user_id` = me) | `o.user_id == me` | own rows (`user_id` = me) / `o.user_id == me` | nobody |
| `official_events` | everyone (signed in) | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `payments` | own rows (`user_id` = me) | `o.user_id == me and o.provider == 'stub'` | nobody | nobody |
| `plans` | everyone (signed in) | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `profiles` | everyone (signed in) | nobody | own rows (`user_id` = me) / `o.user_id == me and o.age is not None and (o.age >= 18)` | nobody |
| `ratings` | everyone (signed in) | `o.rater_id == me and is_member(me, o.table_id)` | nobody | nobody |
| `reports` | own rows (`reporter_id` = me); admins: all | `o.reporter_id == me` | admins only / `True` | nobody |
| `requests` | `Q(user_id=me) \| Q(table_id__in=my_hosted_table_ids(me))` | custom rule `_requests_insert` | own rows (`user_id` = me) / custom rule `_request_update_check` | nobody |
| `subscription_orders` | own rows (`user_id` = me); admins: all | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `subscriptions` | own rows (`user_id` = me); admins: all | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `tables` | custom rule `_tables_select` | `o.host_id == me and o.event_datetime is not None and (o.event_datetime > context.now())` | own rows (`host_id` = me) / `o.host_id == me` | own rows (`host_id` = me) |
| `taste_profiles` | own rows (`user_id` = me) | `o.user_id == me` | own rows (`user_id` = me) / `o.user_id == me` | own rows (`user_id` = me) |
| `tutors` | `Q(status='approved') \| Q(user_id=me) \| (EVERYTHING if a.is_admin else NOTHING)` | `o.user_id == me and Profile.objects.filter(pk=me, onboarded_at__isnull=False).exists()` | own rows (`user_id` = me) / `o.user_id == me` | own rows (`user_id` = me) |
| `waitlist` | `Q(user_id=me) \| Q(table_id__in=my_hosted_table_ids(me))` | custom rule `_waitlist_insert` | nobody | own rows (`user_id` = me) |
| `wednesday_groups` | admins only | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `wednesday_participants` | own rows (`user_id` = me) | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `wednesday_restaurants` | admins only | nobody | nobody | nobody |
| `wednesday_signups` | own rows (`user_id` = me); admins: all | nobody | nobody | nobody |

Custom rules (source, `a` = the signed-in user, `a.uid` = me):

```python
def _lesson_participants_select(a):
    if a.is_admin:
        return EVERYTHING
    return Q(student_id=a.uid) | Q(lesson__tutor_id=a.uid)
```

```python
def _lessons_select(a):
    if a.is_admin:
        return EVERYTHING
    now = context.now()
    approved = Tutor.objects.filter(user_id=OuterRef('tutor_id'), status='approved')
    return (Q(tutor_id=a.uid)
            | Q(Exists(LessonParticipant.objects.filter(lesson_id=OuterRef('pk'), student_id=a.uid)))
            | (Q(kind='group', status='scheduled', starts_at__gt=now) & Q(Exists(approved))))
```

```python
def _request_update_check(a, r):
    # The old policy let people set any status on their own request (even
    # 'approved', then join). The app only ever confirms an approved seat.
    if r.user_id != a.uid:
        return False
    old = getattr(r, '_old_status', None)
    return r.status == old or (old == 'approved' and r.status == 'confirmed')
```

```python
def _requests_insert(a, r):
    if r.user_id != a.uid:
        return False
    now = context.now()
    t = Table.objects.filter(pk=r.table_id, event_datetime__gt=now, status='open').values('host_id').first()
    if not t:
        return False
    return not Block.objects.filter(Q(blocker_id=a.uid, blocked_id=t['host_id'])
                                    | Q(blocker_id=t['host_id'], blocked_id=a.uid)).exists()
```

```python
def _tables_select(a):
    if a.uid is None:
        return NOTHING
    now = context.now()
    blocked = Block.objects.filter(Q(blocker_id=a.uid) | Q(blocked_id=a.uid))
    blocked_ids = {b if bl == a.uid else bl for bl, b in blocked.values_list('blocker_id', 'blocked_id')}
    permissive = (Q(event_datetime__gt=now, status='open')
                  & ~Q(host_id__in=blocked_ids)
                  & ~Q(host__deactivated_at__isnull=False)) | Q(host_id=a.uid)
    # people with a seat keep seeing their table after the event (to rate it,
    # pick connections, read the chat); the old policy hid it once it was past
    seated = list(Membership.objects.filter(user_id=a.uid).values_list('table_id', flat=True))
    if seated:
        permissive |= Q(id__in=seated)
    if viewer_sees_all_cities(a) or a.is_admin:
        return permissive
    # official events (hosted by the team) are open to every city, like Wednesday Dinner
    from .models import OfficialEvent
    restrictive = (Q(host_id=a.uid) | Q(id__in=my_table_ids(a))
                   | Q(Exists(OfficialEvent.objects.filter(table_id=OuterRef('pk')))))
    home = viewer_home_city(a)
    if home is not None:
        restrictive |= Q(city=home)
    return permissive & restrictive
```

```python
def _waitlist_insert(a, w):
    return (w.user_id == a.uid
            and Table.objects.filter(pk=w.table_id, event_datetime__gt=context.now(), status='open').exists())
```

Tables without an entry (e.g. `lesson_rooms`, `jobs`, `auth_tokens`, `storage_objects`) are not readable or writable through `/rest/v1/query`.
